summary.intent: Execute Phase 60 ('IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout') of the CipherBox GSD workflow, hardening IPNS verification across Rust and TypeScript layers using wave-based sequential subagent execution.
summary.outcome: Completed 6 of 8 plans (Waves 1 and 2 partially): relocated and hardened the Rust verify chokepoint, unified first-publish seq=1 across 9 producers, enforced strict fail-closed TS resolve, routed all Rust consumers fail-closed, tightened the API regime, and started cross-language vector regeneration (60-07 in flight at transcript end).

repo: crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs is the canonical IPNS verify chokepoint shared by sdk/fuse/desktop after 60-01 relocation; crates/fuse/src/verify.rs was deleted in 60-04 as it became an empty re-export.
All 9 first-publish IPNS producers (FUSE, desktop Tauri, sdk-core, web) were previously emitting sequence=0; the strict verifier requires sequence=1.
VerifyError::Legacy variant (D-04) was fully removed; all 9 FUSE caller arms were folded to Invalid during 60-01 compile necessity, pre-empting 60-04's declared scope.
sdk-core has 251 tests including 34 ipns-specific tests that serve as the cross-plan integration gate between waves.
Pre-existing dead-code warnings from vendored fuser crate appear on all fuse cargo checks — not regressions.
Windows WinFSP site verification is CI-gated and cannot be confirmed locally.

code.finding: Had a VerifyError::Legacy reference that was converted to VerifyError::Invalid during 60-01; grep confirmed zero remaining Legacy references post-execution.
Had a stale expectation of 0n for IPNS sequence that needed updating to 1n after 60-02 unified all producers to seq=1.
A stray self-check footer was appended after the SUMMARY commit, falsely reporting 'verify.rs FOUND' — became incorrect after 60-04 deleted verify.rs; required manual revert.

workflow: Worktree-isolated parallel subagents are not viable when agents must merge back to a shared branch; sequential execution on the feature branch is the safe fallback for crypto-critical phases.
The GSD commit helper emits a false-negative 'commit_failed / No staged files match any configured task' even when the commit lands — always verify with git log before treating as a real failure.
Subagent executors can leave uncommitted Cargo.lock drift after editing Cargo.toml; must be caught and committed manually between waves to avoid latent --locked CI breaks.
Mid-edit compiler diagnostics captured in executor output can be stale snapshots — always re-run cargo check/grep authoritatively before acting on reported errors.
Wave post-merge build/test gates should cover both cargo check on touched crates AND full unit tests for cross-plan integration (e.g., sdk-core tests catching 60-01 ↔ 60-02 interactions).

friction: GSD commit helper false-negative ('commit_failed') on a successful commit required an extra git log verification step — known issue but adds noise and uncertainty.
60-01 executor was forced to fold FUSE VerifyError::Legacy caller arms (declared scope of 60-04) as a compile necessity, blurring plan boundaries and creating confusion about who owned those changes.

Wave 1 executors left two uncommitted artifacts (Cargo.lock with new ciborium/cipherbox-core deps, stale SUMMARY footer) that required manual orchestrator intervention before Wave 2 could proceed cleanly.
Stale mid-edit E0599 diagnostic for VerifyError::Legacy caused an unnecessary verification detour (grep + cargo check) before continuing.
Worktree-isolated parallel execution had to be abandoned in favor of sequential execution, increasing wall-clock time for an 8-plan phase.
open_items: 60-07 (regenerate cross-language IPNS verify vectors via npx tsx, reclassify legacy-absent and first-publish-skew to invalid) — in flight at transcript end, Wave 2 not yet gated.
60-06 (API publish-path verify cache for CPU cost recovery) — Wave 3, not yet started.
60-08 (D-01/D-12 operational cutover: staging wipe + redeploy + smoke-test) — Wave 4, non-autonomous, requires human checkpoint action.
Phase-level verification and completion (STATE/ROADMAP updates, verify-work gate) — deferred until all 8 plans finish.

Cargo.lock regeneration gap noted in existing memory (release-please bumps Cargo.toml but never regenerates Cargo.lock) — this phase manually committed a Cargo.lock update but the systemic CI gap remains.
